contract: SQL three-valued logic and null vs missing field handling (P01-T01 / P01-T07)

cases.contract_citation: SQL-92 IS NULL predicate: explicit null satisfies IS NULL
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM s WHERE x IS NULL

cases.contract_citation: JSON stream semantics: missing key evaluates as null for IS NULL
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM s WHERE missing_col IS NULL

cases.contract_citation: SQL-92 3VL: NULL = NULL is UNKNOWN (falsy in WHERE)
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM s WHERE a = b
SELECT coalesce(missing_col, x, 42) AS v FROM s

cases.contract_citation: SQL-92: arithmetic with NULL yields NULL
cases.sql: SELECT a + 1 AS v FROM s
